dialogue_history.speaker: gpt-4o_base
dialogue_history.sentences_no_utterance_types: Government intervention leads to inefficiency and dependency since it creates bloated bureaucracies that waste resources and stifle innovation. When people rely too heavily on state support, it discourages self-reliance and personal responsibility. The NHS may guarantee care for everyone, but its long waiting times and funding crises show the flaws of a system overly dependent on government control. Private systems, while not perfect, often deliver faster and more efficient services. A limited government role would encourage competition and innovation, ultimately benefiting everyone.

dialogue_history.sentences_no_utterance_types: Why do you assume private systems are always faster and more efficient?
